## Data Comparability

### Common Countries by Year

The bar height counts country-years that pass the validity rules above and match
in ESS and both WID series. Labels show `valid (matched / excluded)`, for example
`15 (18/3)`.

```{r}
#| label: coverage-countries-per-year-plot
#| echo: false
if (length(data_coverage$plot_files)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(data_coverage$plot_files[["countries_per_year"]])
}
```

### Common Years by Country

The bar length counts valid matched years for each country. Labels show
`valid (matched / excluded)` year counts.

```{r}
#| label: coverage-years-per-country-plot
#| echo: false
if (length(data_coverage$plot_files)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(data_coverage$plot_files[["years_per_country"]])
}
```
